# Ambrose Kerr

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly fifty years old  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Ambrose Kerr is an odd-looking man with long untrimmed hair and a long beard, causing him to resemble an ancient Viking when standing alongside a golden-haired companion. After fifteen years of remaining unshaven and unclipped, he had his hair and beard trimmed by a barber upon the Liberal political victory.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c35 P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032)_

## Personality

Ambrose is a clever, sharp, and widely read individual who lacks moderation in his political convictions. He is exceedingly resolute and possesses a strength of will that leads him to stick stubbornly to his promises. He also possesses a somewhat quick temper.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c37 P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017)_

## History

Ambrose Kerr was raised as a Grit and fiercely campaigned for the Liberal side during a general election fifteen years earlier. Confident in a victory, he publicly swore not to shave his face or trim his hair until the Grits achieved power. Because the Liberals failed to win for fifteen years, he faithfully kept his promise and grew long hair and a beard. He spent time going cod-fishing with Captain Saul and visited the lighthouse, where he entertained others by telling tales, singing Scotch ballads in an excellent tenor voice, and dancing with Lorna. When the Liberals finally won the election, he forced the barber Gus to trim his hair and beard before sunrise. He later married Winifred Tolley, and the couple settled into a comfortable green house.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c35 P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032), [v4 c38 P37](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0037), [v4 c40 P11](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0011)_
